evidence.note: Claim: a widening that re-states a glob the item ALREADY HOLDS while adding an unrelated free file is refused 'queued behind <waiter>'. Mechanism: services/leases/lifecycle.py plan_retarget (lines 186-200) computes want = accepted globs minus the held lease globs (mine_glob) before WG.queue_ahead; api/lifecycle/reservations.py _queued_blocker (153-154) does the same for the claim path, so a re-stated held glob is not judged a new demand. Refutation: the widening SUCCEEDS and names no contention. Verdict on current main: REFUTED-as-live -- the fix already landed via fix-B-update-globs-queued-refusal-vague (merged 67ee252f6); this item's change is the B-widen-refused-specific regression test tests/test_glob_update_overlap.py::test_widening_keeps_a_held_glob_a_waiter_queued_for, which PASSES (bug no longer reproducible).

Read the lease/wait contract in ddflow/services/waiting.py (module docstring: queue_ahead is the optional FIFO; register records lease.waiting) and ddflow/config_sections/lease.py wait_queue doc. The held-glob exemption ('a requested glob the item ALREADY HOLDS is re-stated, not newly demanded') already governs both plan_retarget and _queued_blocker. Regression test follows tests/test_glob_update_overlap.py conventions (run_cli/helpers.items_of, AI.update/A.claim).

No source change needed: the code-level fix for the re-stated-held-glob queue refusal already landed on main via fix-B-update-globs-queued-refusal-vague (plan_retarget services/leases/lifecycle.py:186-200 computes want minus mine_glob; _queued_blocker api/lifecycle/reservations.py:153-154 mirrors it). This item's commit 55f800ed2 adds the B-widen-refused-specific regression test tests/test_glob_update_overlap.py::test_widening_keeps_a_held_glob_a_waiter_queued_for (red-b re-states tests/test_no_agent_literals.py it holds while red-h queued for it, adding only docs/ddflow/research/driver-inventory.md), asserting the widening is accepted and both globs are kept.

chunk_findings.detail: The change contains only a regression test; there is no production-code modification in the manifest or diff. On the unfixed implementation described in the intent, `AI.update` for `RB` while `RH` is queued for the re-stated held glob is refused, so the assertion `assert ok.ok, ok.reason` fails. As submitted, this change does not fix bug B-widen-refused-on-own-held-glob and will make the test suite fail if the underlying bug is still present.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_glob_update_overlap.py:test_widening_keeps_a_held_glob_a_waiter_queued_for

chunk_findings.detail: The test’s docstring promises “no false wait cycle is recorded,” but the test never invokes `ddflow lanes` or inspects wait/lease state. An implementation that allowed the update but still recorded `RB` waiting on `RH` would pass every assertion in this test. It also does not cover the promised refusal-message behavior: the refusal should name the one contended glob rather than “those globs,” but the only scenario here expects success, so that path is not exercised.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_glob_update_overlap.py:test_widening_keeps_a_held_glob_a_waiter_queued_for

chunk_findings.detail: The regression never inspects waiting state, so it does not lock the failure the bug and the docstring name. After `AI.update` returns ok and the glob list matches, nothing reads `lease.waiting` or the lane graph. A widening that grants `docs/ddflow/research/driver-inventory.md` and still records RB waiting on red-h — red-h holds nothing RB needs, `ddflow lanes` shows the two-lane cycle — leaves both assertions true.
chunk_findings.title: tests/test_glob_update_overlap.py:test_widening_keeps_a_held_glob_a_waiter_queued_for

chunk_findings.detail: The other acceptance criterion is untested: a refusal must name the one contended glob instead of "those globs". This case only re-states a held glob plus a free file and asserts success. Input that still shows the wording bug — keep `tests/test_no_agent_literals.py`, add one free path and one glob another lane queued for first — never runs, so `ok.reason` can stay "those globs are queued behind …" and this test stays green.
